title_template: {work_unit_id} — Human-by-Exception readiness decision after Writer Lease hygiene
goal: Make one separate governed decision from the canonical WU-124 post-hygiene reassessment, determining whether Human-by-Exception operation is ready under existing already-canonical authority only, while preserving all owner, runtime, security, release, ruleset, ADWF, WAIT and STOP boundaries and without implicitly creating any new mutation authority.
scope: fresh-read canonical WU-124 reassessment, current main, provider-state and Writer Lease registry before decision
verify WU-124 exact-head CI and completion lease lifecycle evidence before relying on the reassessment
decide readiness only for operation within authority that was already canonical before this decision
preserve WAIT_ONLY, STOP_ONLY, SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED and OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED classifications exactly
state explicitly whether Human-by-Exception operating mode is approved, deferred or blocked under existing authority only
advance only to the next separately governed operationalization or remediation frontier determined by the decision
forbidden_scope: interpret READY_WITH_EXISTING_AUTHORITY_ONLY as a grant of provider-state, merge, runtime, product, release, ruleset, ADWF or higher-autonomy mutation authority
weaken owner escalation or runtime qualification boundaries
change Writer Lease ownership or historical registry records as a side effect of the decision
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime, ADWF binding/repository, release/tag/promotion, ruleset/security policy, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: canonical WU-124 reassessment remains exact and fresh enough for the decision boundary
post-WU-124 Provider Truth is non-contradictory and current ownership is unambiguous
decision distinguishes readiness under existing authority from any request for new authority
all intentional owner/runtime/security/release/ruleset/ADWF and WAIT/STOP boundaries remain explicit
decision itself grants no direct provider-state, runtime, product, release, ruleset, ADWF or higher-autonomy mutation authority
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
